P_holdback.quote: Publicly identifying drafting problems may prompt lawmakers to fix them, which could strengthen the bill. Some of these points may be more effective raised privately with committee staff.

P_grandfather_step.quote: The cutoff is keyed to enactment, not the §8 effective date, so licenses issued during the 180-day window would qualify. This is favorable to [ORG] but invites criticism that the bill rewards a rush to issue licenses.

P_reliance_caveat.quote: Several grandfather and exemption arguments are litigation positions, not compliance plans, and the willfulness standard in §5(b) makes reliance risky.
